items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I never knew his last name. Yeah, a few people talked about him.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember. He was on the show together. Did you call him Little Mac? Yeah, Mac Lacey. Yeah, Little Mac, yeah. Little Mac, I heard him. Little Mac, yeah. Little Mac, yeah. I never knew his last name. Yeah, a few people talked about him. I'm in trouble, man. I wish he would have been calling him. I mean, I wish he'd heard him, man.
What about that old man, Cottrell?
